race.comment: SHINDY (9) recorded her first win last start over 1600m at this track, getting home by a long neck. Re-unites with Lachlan Neindorf who was on board last start. Capable of making it two on the trot. CHIHULY (2) continues to leave himself with too much to do but is savaging the line. If Egan can have him rolling prior to the turn he's a chance to reel them in and break a long run of outs. VERONA RUPES (1) was back in winning form last start at Mildura over  1900m. First time tested at this trip but he deserves respect. NOTHINGELSEMATTERS (3) finds a more suitable assignment back to this grade and gets a key booking in Brown. Worth including.
